sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!

sprite_sequence.text: Why today of all days? My alarm worked! I know it did!

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s suddenly panicked and flustered, with a sharp spike of anxiety as she realizes her missing pass could make her already-late morning even worse.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on, don't do this to me!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is panicked and flustered, desperately trying to keep herself together while feeling the pressure of being late on the very first day.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Seriously... I stopped to read that creepy note, and now my pass is gone?

sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: I'm late, I'm cardless, and I'm trying very hard not to become a tragedy in a school uniform.

sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp jolt of disbelief and wary suspicion, with a flicker of hope underneath as she realizes the creepy note may have been leading her somewhere on purpose.

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is breathless and panicked but also energized by the urgency, pushing through embarrassment with determined, apologetic momentum.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sudden, breathless relief and grateful excitement, with a burst of hopeful energy after the earlier panic.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and instantly wary, with her earlier panic shifting into tense suspicion as she tries to figure out how this stranger knows so much about her.

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, wow. That's not a normal sentence.

sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Did my friends put you up to this? Because this prank is way too elaborate for eight in the morning.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels startled but trying to regain control with joking suspicion, masking a spike of unease and curiosity behind her usual bold, talkative energy.

sprite_sequence.text: That made it worse. You know that, right?

sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is jolted into alarmed disbelief, trying to reject the eerie situation outright while masking her fear with blunt, emphatic denial.
sprite_sequence.label: unconvinced

sprite_sequence.text: People do not just vanish before homeroom!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is jolted from disbelief into alarmed, indignant panic, trying to assert normal logic out loud because the situation has become too eerie and impossible for her to comfortably process.
sprite_sequence.label: angry

sprite_sequence.text: Aah— school! Mystery later, attendance first!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is forcing herself into brisk, upbeat determination to stay in control, using humor and urgency to push past her fear and confusion.

sprite_sequence.text: Seat by the window, huh... If that's true, who were you?

sprite_sequence.label: interested_attentive

gpt.rationale: The sequence is broadly expressive and proactive in an extroverted way, with strong fits for panic, sarcasm, outrage, and quick recovery, but repeated exasperated/unconvinced sprites flatten a few distinct beats like relief turning to alarm and lingering fear/curiosity.

claude.rationale: Sprites consistently reflect an extroverted, expressive personality with visible frustration and curiosity; emotional progression is coherent and mostly precise, though the shift to cheerful at 'Oh, thank goodness!' slightly underplays the creeping unease that should dominate once the stranger's behavior becomes clearly abnormal.
